verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents defining infrastructure in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, .NET, and Java, each with full provider coverage, and explicitly uses standard language features like loops, functions, classes, and package management. Community users corroborate the type-system benefits (e.g. TypeScript typing) and the value of a real programming language. Some users find the apply/output model complex, but that does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence of IDE support (autocomplete/IntelliSense tooling), and independent corroboration of the IDE experience.
